create_gym_env_from_config: create a gym environment from an OmegaConf config using EnvHandler.make_env with env string or env_cfg
run_env_rollout_with_plan: run a rollout in a gym env using EnvHandler.rollout_env with a plan or agent and lookahead steps
get_env_current_state: get the internal state of a gym environment using EnvHandler.get_current_state for later restoration
set_env_state_from_tuple: set a gym environment back to a previous state using EnvHandler.set_env_state with a saved state tuple
make_env_from_string_name: create a new gym environment from its string description using EnvHandler.make_env_from_str
